description: Create a new public or announcement thread from an existing message in a text or announcement channel. The new thread gets the same ID as the source message, so a message can have only one thread. Not supported in forum or media channels. Returns the created thread. To create a standalone thread without a starter message, use discord_create_thread. Bot permissions it may need: Create Public Threads, View Channel, Read Message History. Changes Discord data and is not idempotent; check the result before retrying.

auto_archive_duration.description: Duration in minutes to automatically archive thread after inactivity: 60, 1440, 4320, or 10080

channel_id.description: ID of the parent channel containing the message

message_id.description: ID of the message to branch the thread from

name.description: Title or name of the new thread (1-100 characters)

rate_limit_per_user.description: Slowmode delay per user in seconds (0-21600)

reason.description: Audit log reason for creating the thread
